q: What golf leagues are there at The Bogey Club in Newmarket?
a: Men's Night is a 24-week indoor golf league that runs every Tuesday from November to April, and The Bogey Cup is a four-week, four-round tournament with a new one starting every month. Both are played on our Golfzon simulators at 17705 Leslie Street in Newmarket. We also host The Bogey Club Classic outdoor tournament and one-off events like two-man scrambles.

q: How does The Bogey Cup work?
a: The Bogey Cup is four rounds over four weeks, with a full week to submit each round. It uses Stableford scoring, with weekly skins and closest-to-the-pin prizes awarded every week.
Every Tuesday from November 3, 2026 to April 27, 2027, with a standing 7 PM tee time. Can't make 7 PM? Play any time that Tuesday to get your score in. Register online through Golf Genius.

q: How much does Men's Night cost?
a: $999 for one season or $1,799 for both seasons, and you can also pay weekly. There are only 32 official roster spots: the first 32 to register are on the roster, and after that you join the waitlist.

q: How do I join a golf league?
a: Register for Men's Night online through Golf Genius. To join the next Bogey Cup or ask about an event, call (905) 235-4653 or email golf@thebogeyclub.com.

q: Is The Bogey Club Classic played indoors?
a: No. The Bogey Club Classic is our annual outdoor tournament, played over one round.
